callouts.title: 版本1：an epsilon of room
callouts.body:
1. 要证明一个命题$S_0$,这个命题涉及一个对象$x_0$(比如一个值，或者一个函数等等)
2. 不妨证明一个命题$S_{\varepsilon}$以及一个对象$x_{\varepsilon}$，这个命题更容易操作(意味着可以下手的工具更多)，从而比原来的问题更容易处理。
3. 如果$S_{\varepsilon}$对任意$\varepsilon >0$成立，它能导出$S_0$。

if_strategy_template.summary_en: To prove a target statement \(S_0\) about an object \(x_0\), replace it by a more tractable statement \(S_{\\varepsilon}\) about a perturbed object \(x_{\\varepsilon}\). If \(S_{\\varepsilon}\) holds for every \(\\varepsilon>0\) and implies \(S_0\) in the limit, then the original statement follows.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when the original object or statement is hard to handle directly, but small perturbations create extra structure, flexibility, or available tools.

callouts.title: 版本2:把无穷问题转换为有限问题
callouts.body:
1. 如果要证明一个命题$S_{\infty}$，此命题涉及一个对象$x_{\infty}$。
2. 我们不妨去证明一个更弱的命题$S_{N}$或者$S_h$，这个命题涉及一个对象$x_{N}$或者$x_h$,这是一个有限的固定的问题。但是如果这个有限的问题，对于一定程度上任意的参数$N$或者$h$成立那么原来的命题被证明。

classification_result.english_title: Version 2: Convert an Infinite Problem into a Finite Problem

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Convert an Infinite Problem into a Finite Problem
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Instead of proving a statement \(S_{\\infty}\) directly, prove a weaker but finite version such as \(S_N\) or \(S_h\), involving a fixed finite parameter. If this finite statement holds uniformly for sufficiently arbitrary \(N\) or \(h\), then the original infinite statement is established.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when an infinite, asymptotic, or limiting problem can be approximated or reduced to finite truncations, discretizations, or fixed-parameter cases.

callouts.title: 版本3:先证明在性质更好的对象上成立，然后过渡
callouts.body:
1. 命题$S_0$涉及的对象$x_0$如果我们替换为一个性质更好的对象$x_{\varepsilon}$,这个命题是否还能成立。
2. 这个新的命题我们称之为$S_{\varepsilon}$.如果这个新的命题是成立的，并且对任意$\varepsilon$成立，并且我们可以把新的命题过渡到原有命题上(过渡的手法多种多样)，问题就解决了。

classification_result.english_title: Version 3: First Prove It for Better-Behaved Objects, Then Pass to the Original One

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Prove First on Better-Behaved Objects, Then Pass to the Limit
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Replace the original object \(x_0\) in the statement \(S_0\) by a better-behaved object \(x_{\\varepsilon}\), and prove the corresponding statement \(S_{\\varepsilon}\). If this works for every \(\\varepsilon\) and one can transfer the result back to the original setting, then \(S_0\) follows.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a rough, singular, or poorly structured object can be approximated by smoother or more regular objects for which the argument is easier.
